sources.citation: Plummer, L. N., Parkhurst, D. L., Fleming, G. W., and Dunkle, S. A. (1988), A computer program incorporating Pitzer's equations for calculation of geochemical reactions in brines, U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 88-4153.
sources.reuse_note: USGS states that USGS-authored or produced reports and data are in the U.S. public domain and asks users to acknowledge USGS. Third-party items remain excluded unless separately cleared.

sources.citation: Hamer, W. J., and Wu, Y.-C. (1972), Osmotic coefficients and mean activity coefficients of uni-univalent electrolytes in water at 25 degrees C, Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data, 1, 1047-1100.
sources.publisher: National Bureau of Standards and American Institute of Physics
sources.reuse_note: NIST distinguishes protected Standard Reference Data, NIST-authored works, and third-party works. The exact status of redistributing this journal compilation in an app has not yet been confirmed.
sources.scientific_role: Independent evaluated reference values derived from experimental literature.
sources.app_compatibility_note: The binary salt-water tables do not prescribe pH, while the app requires a fixed pH input. A documented neutral-pH convention and sensitivity check are required before release.

sources.publisher: National Bureau of Standards for NASA
sources.reuse_note: The NTRS catalog says Work of the US Government, Public Use Permitted, but the report title page contains an older reproduction restriction. Resolve that conflict before redistribution.
sources.scientific_role: Potential independent evaluated reference source for future electrolyte components.
